Chilli oil noodles 🌶️🔥🍜

Ingredients:
• 200g wheat noodles
• 2 tbsp chilli oil
• 1 tbsp soy sauce
• 1 tsp rice vinegar
• 1 spring onion, sliced

Method:
1. Boil the noodles for 3 minutes and drain.
2. Toss with the chilli oil, soy sauce and vinegar.
3. Top with the spring onion.

Save this for later! 💾
#noodles #chillioil #easydinner #fyp
